item.title: Cape Flats youth team makes history with Cape2Rio yacht race victory
item.description: Alexforbes Angel Wings, a youth team with sailors from the Cape Flats representing the Royal Cape Yacht Club (RCYC) Sailing Academy, has claimed first place on handicap in the 2025 Cape2Rio race. They have made history as the first such team to earn their place and take victory in the 3,300-nautical mile transatlantic crossing.
